verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no official Logseq CLI. The closest items are adjacent rather than a CLI: the logseq:// protocol quick-capture URL can be 'opened from command line shell', and the local HTTP API server can be called with curl. A protocol handler and an HTTP API are not an official command-line tool, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
